caption: An AI treasurer for student clubs, built on PayPal
text: ClubPay. An AI treasurer for student clubs, built on PayPal.

caption: Clubs run their money on group chats and spreadsheets
text: Every student club runs its money through a group chat and a spreadsheet. Members pay out of pocket, then wait weeks to be paid back. And when the treasurer graduates, the records leave with them.

caption: One place for the club's budget, payouts and dues
text: This is ClubPay. The dashboard shows the club's budget by category, what has been paid out, and what is waiting for review.

caption: Gemini reads the receipt and checks it against club rules
text: A member uploads a photo of a receipt. Gemini reads the vendor, the items and the total, checks them against the club's written spending rules and the remaining budget, and recommends approve, with its reasons.

caption: The AI only recommends. A human releases the money
text: This second receipt is from a liquor store. The club's policy bans alcohol, so the AI recommends rejecting it, and says why. The AI only recommends. A human always releases the money.

caption: One click sends a PayPal Payout to the member
text: The treasurer approves with one click. ClubPay sends a PayPal Payout to the member. PayPal confirms it, and the receipt is marked as paid.

caption: Dues are collected with PayPal Invoicing
text: Dues work the same way. Pick the members and an amount, and ClubPay sends each one a PayPal invoice.

caption: The assistant reads the real ledger and can act on it
text: The assistant reads the club's real ledger and PayPal data. Ask who still owes dues, and it can send the reminders itself.

caption: Every transaction in one searchable, exportable ledger
text: Every transaction lands in one ledger, built with AG Grid, that the club can search, filter, and export for its advisor.

caption: React, Express, Google Gemini and PayPal
text: Under the hood: a React app, an Express API, Google Gemini for the AI, and PayPal Payouts, Invoicing and Webhooks for the money.

caption: Snap a receipt. Get paid back.
text: ClubPay. Snap a receipt, get paid back. Try the live demo, and thanks for watching.
